summary: Barclays upgraded SNDK to overweight, PT raised to $2,300 from $1,200. Mizuho raised PT to $1,825 from $1,625 (Outperform). SanDisk secured five-year supply agreements totaling >$42B (three contracts signed last quarter, ~$42B minimum contractual revenue, near-term fixed pricing shifting to variable). Won 2026 Red Dot Design Awards (consumer storage). Stock up >4,000% over past 12 months on AI-related NAND demand. Moved up 5.71% on May 28.
